sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen2.5-Omni: Qwen2.5-Omni is an end-to-end multimodal ...
sources.snippet: We release Qwen2.5-Omni, the new flagship end-to-end multimodal model in the Qwen series. Designed for comprehensive multimodal perception, it seamlessly processes diverse inputs including text, images, audio, and video, while delivering real-time streaming responses through both text generation and natural speech synthesis.
